summary.headline: AI Selloff Deepens, Tech Earnings Disappoint, Binance Hack
summary.tldr: AI companies face capital challenges, tech earnings disappointed investors, and Binance suffered a major hack, all contributing to a volatile week in markets.

key_points.point: AI companies are struggling to raise capital due to high interest rates.
key_points.why_it_matters: This makes it harder for AI firms to fund expensive infrastructure projects.

key_points.point: Alphabet and Intel had their worst trading days ever due to disappointing earnings.
key_points.why_it_matters: This highlights investor concerns about the profitability of major tech companies.

key_points.point: Binance was hacked, with $6.3 billion stolen, leading to a drop in crypto-related stocks.
key_points.why_it_matters: This shows the risks associated with digital currency exchanges and the broader crypto market.

summary.lesson: Markets react strongly to earnings reports and major events like hacks or geopolitical tensions. Even well-known companies can face significant losses if they miss expectations.
opinions_and_predictions: Investors are asking when AI investments will become profitable, indicating skepticism about near-term returns.
The threat of U.S. military strikes against Iran has raised concerns about potential instability in energy markets.
